project.name: site
project.productType: Salon website with online booking (AQP Beauty Studio, Odiongan)

must: Charcoal ground #0e0e0e, warm ink #f5f2ea, one gold accent #c9a75a
Playfair Display for headings with an italic second phrase; Inter for body; tracked uppercase gold labels above headings
Square buttons, flat gold fill, tracked caps; 1px gold hairlines (--line) for borders and dividers
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; keyboard focus ring is 2px gold
Plain CSS in app/globals.css; Next.js 16 (read node_modules/next/dist/docs before using APIs)
avoid: Shadows at rest, glass/backdrop blur, soft rounded corners
Pre-hiding content for animation: elements stay visible and only fade in as they enter the screen

decisions.decision: Rebrand (2026-10-31) after the Aevum / ChronoVault reference: centred ring hero, recent-looks card row, category panels, Playfair + Inter. Replaced the dark-room direction; the hero photo strip became the Recent looks row.
